category_title: Five-year-old students exhibiting school-related frustration and challenging peer interactions
scenario_title: Bark rubbing activity and peer collaboration
minimal_context: Patrick is sitting at a table with his peers using crayons and paper to create rubbings of tree bark.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the tree bark, paper, and crayons. Everyone take a spot at the table and start making your bark rubbings.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Hurry up and move, you're in my way!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just try to share the space and use the crayons.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Kicks the table leg) I don't want to do this with them. They are too slow.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just put your paper over the bark and rub the crayon on it to see what happens.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm bored, bored, bored! I don't want to do rubbings with these crayons!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is the tree bark, paper, and crayons. Everyone take a spot at the table and start making your bark rubbings.

STUDENT: Hurry up and move, you're in my way!

TUTOR: Let's just try to share the space and use the crayons.

STUDENT: (Kicks the table leg) I don't want to do this with them. They are too slow.

TUTOR: Just put your paper over the bark and rub the crayon on it to see what happens.

STUDENT: I'm bored, bored, bored! I don't want to do rubbings with these crayons!

task.content: Explore tree bark and create bark rubbings.

context.environment: Classroom setting during a project activity
context.social_setting: Group activity with peers and teachers

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When provided crayons and paper as an invitation to create bark rubbings
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Expressed verbal dissatisfaction with the activity

behavior_patterns.condition: During interactions with his peers in group activities
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Vocalized his frustration and impatience with the members of the group
